_comment: xpr_cutover_voter config. Copy, fill in, chmod 600. The voter refuses to start if either key file is readable by group or others. pause_height is the ceremony-agreed pause head P (a fixed H+k, strictly past height): every producer stops at P and every confirmation signs P.
source_chain_id: <64 hex chars of the XPR chain id, published with the ceremony>

confirmation._comment: schedule_sha256 is the published hash of the source producer schedule (xpr_snapshot_schedule prints it). It is known before H and always required: the live schedule is checked against it on every poll before H, and the genesis you sign must pin the same value. checkpoint_sha256 (the hash of the checkpoint THIS operator derived from its own Leap snapshot at H, never taken from the coordinator), migration_genesis (pins that checkpoint and the same schedule hash; the successor chain id is derived from it, never adopted) and platform_chain_id (the MetalGo blockchain id wallets sign under, configured and never adopted) only exist after H, so a ceremony agent starts the voter with operator_fed set and restarts it as each lands. Without operator_fed, leaving any of the three out refuses to load. The pause never waits on them; signing needs all three. coordinator_url is optional: when set, its params are cross-checked against all of the above and the local node.
confirmation.schedule_sha256: <64 hex chars: the published source schedule hash>
confirmation.checkpoint_sha256: <64 hex chars: the checkpoint hash this operator derived itself>
confirmation.platform_chain_id: <64 hex chars of the MetalGo blockchain id, published with the ceremony>

stop_producer._comment: Opt-in local halt. When at_pause is true, the voter pauses its own producer (Leap producer/pause) once the ceremony is finalized on-chain (this voter's own declaration, not any ceremony) and the local head has reached P, then proves it is paused (Leap answers /v1/producer/paused with a bare boolean). A contract cannot stop block production, only the producer can. Omit or set at_pause false and the voter signs without ever pausing. producer_api_url must be the LOCAL producer node, not a shared API endpoint. at_h was removed: configs still carrying it are refused.
